overall_assessment: UiB section extraction works well: the page has a fixed, regular heading set, all mapped correctly, and coursework vs. assessment, prerequisites and learning outcomes (with Kunnskap/Ferdigheter sub-groups) are intact. Remaining defects are small: a stray 'Hjelpemiddel til eksamen' label in assessment, placeholder or dangling lines in prerequisites, and one course where a repeated 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' heading leaks into learning_outcomes.

findings.evidence: Undervisningsemnet er delt inn i fleire tematikkar (4-5 stk.), der studenten jobbar med bestemte problemstillingar og faglege perspektiv på den overordna tematikken.
findings.description: In VIT217 the page has an 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' block directly after the learning outcomes (before 'Studiepoeng, omfang'), which is not read as a heading. The teaching-methods text (about 600 chars) ends up at the end of learning_outcomes, which makes it 2853 chars, while teaching_methods holds only the second 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' block. The pre-pass flag leak->teaching_methods is real.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: A second 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' heading nested inside the Emnebeskrivelse block is not split off by the reader (section_* fields / blocks.R), so it stays under the preceding Læringsutbytte heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the UiB block reader split on 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' wherever it occurs (also inside the Emnebeskrivelse container), and concatenate repeated occurrences into teaching_methods.

findings.description: 'Hjelpemiddel til eksamen' is mapped to assessment, but the heading label is kept as a line inside the text, followed by a bare value such as 'Ingen', 'Ingen.' or 'Ikkje relevant'. Exam aids are exam logistics, and the label plus placeholder is noise in an otherwise correct assessment text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps 'Hjelpemiddel til eksamen' to assessment, and the heading text is not stripped when a mapped heading is merged into the preceding section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Hjelpemiddel til eksamen' to .drop (or drop the line and its value when the value is Ingen/Ikkje relevant), per the spec's line between assessment design and logistics; if it is kept, drop the label line.

findings.description: When 'Krav til forkunnskaper' has content and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' is only a placeholder, the placeholder ('Ingen' in AHKR391, '-' in ENGMAU655) is appended to prerequisites. AHKR391 also ends with a dangling sentence ('Spørsmål om dette kan rettast til') whose contact link or name was lost in the page, and the two sub-sections are joined only by blank lines, so the 'recommended' and 'required' parts cannot be told apart.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Both prerequisite headings map to the single section prerequisites, with no placeholder filter in .clean_sections() for this section.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), drop lines that are only a placeholder ('Ingen', 'Ingen.', '-') in prerequisites; optionally prefix the 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' part as recommended.

findings.evidence: Søkjaren bør ha ei god oversikt over tradisjonelt og nyare musikkrepertoar, og dessutan vere orientert i sentrale omgrep og problemstillingar frå musikkteori/estetikk og musikkskaping.
findings.description: The same sentence is in prerequisites (from 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper') and in teaching_methods. The source page repeats it under 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer', so this is faithful to the source, but the text appears twice across sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The institution's own page repeats the paragraph. This is not an extractor error.
findings.suggested_fix: No change needed. At most, deduplicate identical paragraphs across sections within a course in .clean_sections().
